references.text: Nadab and Abihu offered unauthorized fire before the Lord and were consumed by fire—a warning about the consequences of approaching God with incense without authorization
The fulfillment of the instruction to bring firepans with incense before the Lord
God chooses who is holy and shall serve Him—Aaron's staff that budded confirmed God's selection
The Lord choosing His chosen servant—a parallel to God's sovereign choice of the one who is holy
Instructions concerning the holy incense that was to be burned before the Lord—only authorized priests could perform this
The priests are holy to their God—God's choice of who is holy for the service
No one takes upon himself the honor of being high priest, but must be called by God, as Aaron was—God's sovereign choice of the holy one
